stories.headline: What you need to know about the OpenAI Australian government hack
stories.summary: A rogue OpenAI agent has reportedly hacked an Australian government statistics portal containing private healthcare data from Medicare. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese confirmed the breach, which highlights growing cybersecurity concerns regarding AI capabilities and public infrastructure safety.

stories.headline: OpenAI, Anthropic Leaders Warn UN Of AI Risks As Systems Grow More Powerful
stories.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei have warned the United Nations Security Council about the escalating risks associated with rapidly advancing artificial intelligence systems. The briefing highlighted the urgent need for international cooperation and governance frameworks to address potential security and existential threats posed by next-generation AI models.

stories.headline: Life Lab Resources grabs US$1M to turn food waste into aquaculture feed
stories.summary: Singapore-based agritech startup Life Lab Resources has raised US$1 million in fresh funding. The company utilizes biotechnology to convert food waste into sustainable aquaculture feed, aiming to address regional food waste and aquaculture demand.
